Hyperbot MCP Server - Feature Description
Hyperbot Trading Analytics MCP Server is a blockchain trading analytics platform providing real-time cryptocurrency data and AI-powered analysis tools via Model Context Protocol.
Key Features
Smart Money Tracking: Real-time leaderboard of high-performing traders ranked by PnL and win rate. Discover smart money addresses, analyze trade history, and generate copy-trading strategies.
Whale Monitoring: Track whale positions and movements in real-time. Monitor open/close events, analyze long/short ratios, and predict market impact from large trader activities.
Market Data: Access real-time tickers, L2 order books, K-line charts, and active order statistics for BTC, ETH, SOL and other major cryptocurrencies.
Trader Analytics: Comprehensive performance metrics including win rate, max drawdown, coin-specific performance, and position history with execution trajectory tracking.
Batch Operations: Query up to 50 addresses simultaneously for efficient portfolio analysis.
AI Prompts: Pre-built analytical frameworks (smart-money-analysis, whale-tracking, market-sentiment, trader-evaluation) with JSON output optimized for AI agents.
Technical: RESTful API, JSON-RPC 2.0, real-time updates, 100 req/min rate limit, SSE support.
